Patch release with icon sprite support for npm consumers.

### Added

- Icon sprite support for npm consumers (`scripts/generate-icon-sprite.mjs`).
- Installation documentation for icon assets and library setup.

### Changed

- Updated package documentation and styles for `@laczynski/lui` branding.

### Install

```bash
npm install @laczynski/lui@1.0.1
```

Docs: https://ui.laczynski.dev/
